'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hello, friend. I guess you've heard about the trader at the Lighthouse. I've got a little ambition, so to speak... I want to get in touch with him personally. No, it's still a long way to go before we meet face to face. And I don't like to leave my lair, honestly. There's a problem: the radio signal can't reach the lighthouse from here. Can you find the parts so I can put together a signal transmitter?}}

==Requirements==
{{Seasonal change|this task cannot currently be obtained in any game mode.}}
To gain access to this quest, you must first reach a [[Scavs#Scav karma|Scav karma]] level of +2. With the required karma level there are 3 ways to unlock it:
* Progressing through the story chapter [[Batya]]
* Progressing through the story chapter [[The Ticket]]
* Completing the quests:
** ?

==Objectives==
* Hand over the 4 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[Electronic components]]
* Hand over the 4 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter|Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitters]]
* Hand over the 4 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[Gas analyzer|Gas analyzers]]
* Hand over the 4 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[Broken GPhone smartphone|Broken GPhone smartphones]]

==Rewards==
* +18,600 [[EXP]]
* [[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.01'''</font>
{{quote|Excellent! That's enough for me to assemble not even one, but three transmitters. That way we can definitely get through to Lightkeeper.}}
